gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-krub: Capture It towers, its lowercase rising tall over nearly sealed letters. Krub, a sans-serif whose pen-lifted curves never quite close, supplies the pull: shuttered shapes above, open loops below.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-kufam: Capture It packs its tall lowercase into nearly shut shapes. Kufam, a sans drawn like neon tubing with wide-open e curves, would move down a page in a smooth, glowing track.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-lexend: Urban and commanding, Capture It crowds its towering lowercase into letters that barely open, nearly sealed shut at every turn. Lexend, a plain sans, reads easily, its open curves keeping the line moving.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-lexend-deca: Lexend Deca reads plainly, an unshaded sans line with big lowercase. Giving Capture It a modest size is enough, since its towering, nearly sealed letters already hold their ground.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-liter: Capture It lifts a towering x-height and nearly closed letters into a commanding, urban voice. And Liter, a sans-serif with no stroke contrast and wide mouths on round forms, does the quieter work of being read.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-mada: Approachable and modern, the body here is a plain sans whose curves refuse to close. Mada would drown Capture It if the heading shrank, since that tall, nearly sealed display face needs room to command.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-martel-sans: Commanding and urban, Capture It hammers out towering lowercase in uniform strokes, with barely a gap anywhere. Martel Sans then opens every curve and lets the lines breathe.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-matangi: Matangi, a sans of twine-like strokes and hefty lowercase, sits beneath a heading built tall and very nearly shut. Capture It is the shout, Matangi the rounded, open reply.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-maven-pro: Maven Pro, a sans, opens a welcoming gap in every c. Its gentle, monotone line and high-waisted lowercase would carry text smoothly, a quiet follow-up to the tall, shuttered shout of Capture It.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-michroma: Michroma, a sans, gives every letter a wide berth and leaves daylight in its curves. But Capture It, tall and nearly sealed, sets a stark urban command against all that space.
